t: The Flomasta 32mm adjustable P trap with swivel connection is designed for standard basins. It provides a 75mm water seal and is made from durable polypropylene for long-lasting performance. The universal compression outlet is suitable for plastic, copper and lead pipes, while the built-in anti-syphon valve neutralises negative syphonic pressure. It is easy to fit in awkward spaces with an adjustable height from 175 to 230mm.
